responsibility: Declares the NameKey API for interning strings into stable integer name identifiers and recovering the original text, including membership tests, reverse lookup, case-insensitive equality, raw char* access, and per-character access. This header defines the compiler/runtime name-key abstraction that SymbolKey builds upon for symbol tables.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file for the GNameKey pair: it defines the public Name type, null-name constant, and interning/query routines, while GNameKey.cc contains the private tree nodes, key allocation state, reverse lookup storage, and comparison logic.
